raw_response: {"diagnosis":"Batch 13 delivered txn_ts as epoch milliseconds (e.g. '1768629617000' = 2026-01-17 06:00:17 UTC, matching the ~06:00 start of other batches) instead of 'YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM:SS' strings, so CAST AS TIMESTAMP fails. The fix is to parse both formats in silver_transactions.","decision":"fix","confidence":0.9,"pre_sql":[],"step_overrides":{"silver_transactions":"CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE silver_transactions AS WITH parsed AS (SELECT txn_id, customer_id, merchant_id, amount, CASE WHEN regexp_matches(txn_ts, '^[0-9]+$') THEN epoch_ms(CAST(txn_ts AS BIGINT)) ELSE CAST(txn_ts AS TIMESTAMP) END AS ts FROM raw_transactions WHERE status = 'POSTED') SELECT CAST(txn_id AS BIGINT) AS txn_id, customer_id, CAST(merchant_id AS INTEGER) AS merchant_id, CAST(amount AS DECIMAL(12,2)) AS amount, CAST(ts AS TIMESTAMP) AS txn_ts, CAST(ts AS DATE) AS txn_date FROM parsed;"}}
